identity.source_compatibility: carried by the MCC scenario manifest and never encoded in the prepared-target ID
identity.php_matrix: applies to Composer skeletons; ZIP has one official upstream target artifact

purpose: MCC-built Composer or ZIP skeleton delivered to MCD without invoking Composer on the host
transport: MCD fetches only the bound artifact path from the configured HTTPS MCC URL with the existing MCC Bearer API key; no GitHub, DNS or alternate network fallback

artifact.integrity: exact size and SHA-256 before extraction
artifact.manifest_integrity: embedded manifest must equal the MCC-provided manifest and every listed payload file must match its SHA-256

apply: materialize the prepared application into the existing upgrade maintenance lifecycle, preserve config and var, run existing migration and health checks, and retain rollback evidence
failure: integrity, layout, version, migration or health failure is terminal and invokes the existing rollback path
